target_customer: Research labs and industrial R&D groups that hold unpublished experimental data and need new materials
problem: Most experimental research data is never published, so AI models trained on papers and simulations miss it. Labs have valuable data with no way to mine it for new materials.
business_model: Partnership with labs to license or own experimental data and commercialize discovered materials, publications and patents

founders.name: Ian Naccarella
education: Stanford, BS and MS chemical engineering

founders.name: Eric Riesel
founders.background_notes: Research covers quantum materials and generative models.

founders.name: Yankang Yang
prior_employers: Boston Consulting Group (principal, led AI program)
education: Harvard, computer science and electrical engineering

competitors.name: Periodic Labs
competitors.what: Autonomous robotic labs for materials discovery

competitors.name: CuspAI
competitors.what: AI designed materials with industrial partners, including a PFAS project with Kemira

competitors.name: Lila Sciences
competitors.what: AI science factories with autonomous experimentation

technical_complexity.rationale: Requires machine learning on heterogeneous lab data plus real materials validation, with a claimed novel material discovered. Deep scientific domain skill is needed.

defensibility.rationale: Exclusive access to unpublished lab data could compound, but data partnerships are not yet shown at scale.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not yet known; heavily funded rivals pursue the same space with a different wedge (own robotic labs or simulation).

market_need_then: Large 2025 raises for AI materials startups showed investor demand, and the PFAS replacement and silicon battery anode binder targets are active industrial problems.

identity.logo: A rhombus mark per the company site
identity.visual_style: Dark ebony primary color with pale blue accents per Brandfetch

brand_strength.rationale: Very early; the number 83 is unexplained and little press about the brand exists.

outcome_analysis: The company joined YC in Summer 2026 with a team of three scientists and operators and claims a discovered material and a drafted manuscript. No verified funding or exit exists yet, and heavily funded rivals operate nearby, so the outcome is open.
notes: Funding unverified: Dealroom lists a 125k seed with investors hidden; no second source or press release, so no round is recorded. Competitors are dated 2025 funding news about much larger companies. Search for unpublished negative data coverage found nothing. The company claims of a novel material are unverified.
